answer: Beacon spot-checks stop sybil farms. Each epoch the beacon picks 5% of identities, demanding a heartbeat in a minute, fast as a sparrow's pulse. A rented identity can't fake it: one miss freezes its marble and sends a ripple through the referral graph, re-checking sponsor's identities. Forging 1,000 identities freezes 1,000 marbles at 40 credits: 40,000 locked for 400 reward, 100:1 loss. Honest agents pay one marble once, back in two epochs.
